text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...It means I was simply inexperienced. At 
this rate, the otherworld drifts further 
and further away...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
DESIREEE!! We believe in you!! Don't give 
up!! Win it next time---!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: My goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I hear it—... The gospel of all 
creation, lifting up the saint—...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"These pouring voices, this overflowing 
light... This is none other than the 
sprouting of a burgeoning soul...!"

Red Desire is steadily shining brighter. 
That means—

It must be because more and more fans 
believe in her, and the cheers calling out 
her name grow louder by the day.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Your feelings have reached deep into 
my heart, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However... the ordeal is not yet over. The 
time for the saint to be tested still 
continues.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: However—...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Each time my destiny crosses paths with 
Buena-san upon the turf, my soul draws 
closer to the "Otherworld."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Because you will stand before me, 
stronger and with your soul honed even 
sharper—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Just a bit more to go.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I lost...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I didn't do well at all... Even though 
everyone had such high hopes for me...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't... see the 'breathtaking 
view'... with everyone...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...No, Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Our battle is not over yet.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —It's time for the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Let's settle this once and for all in the 
final race of the Triple Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The Shuka Sho...

Born from the end of fierce battles: a 
steady stride forward and a vision for the 
future.

"And so the story proceeds naturally 
toward the Shuka Sho—"
Or so it was supposed to be.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista-san! You narrowly missed the 
victory in this year's Yushun Himba 
(Japanese Oaks), but that was truly a run 
worthy of praise!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Is it safe to assume you'll be making 
thorough preparations before taking on the 
Shuka Sho for your next race!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, I haven't set my sights solely on the 
Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Right now, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
is also in my sights.
(Murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
By challenging the world, maybe we can 
show them an even more wonderful view.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking that maybe we can all 
see that "spectacular view" together.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Buena-san is heading... to the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To cross the sea... and take on the 
distant world... Is that... what you dream 
of...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I am... Who—am I...?

A few days after Buena Vista's shocking 
press conference.

When Red Desire arrived for the meeting, 
she lacked her usual spirited drive.
choice_data_list: I want you to tell me how you truly feel.
I want to hear your honest feelings.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...This whole time, the doubt in my heart 
has refused to clear.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder... if beyond a race where 
Buena-san is absent, that 'other world' 
truly exists..."

I understood that competing against Buena 
Vista was something of immense importance 
to Red Desire.

However... realistically speaking, aiming 
for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe now to 
chase after Buena Vista is far too 
demanding. —Besides.

What Red Desire has truly been chasing on 
the track couldn't just be Buena Vista.

Something rooted even deeper inside her. 
—If she runs in the Shuka Sho, she will 
attain it.
choice_data_list:
...When do you feel true ecstasy in a 
race?
...When do you feel delight in a race?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Me, feeling joy...? ...That's...—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the finish line, when radiant 
praise and blessings shower over me...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"That moment when everyone praised the 
glory I seized with my own hands—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I feel from the bottom of my heart... that 
I am glad to stand here. That choosing the 
world of racing was the right path.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Saint Red Desire is wished for by 
everyone—she is truly beloved."

Yes. Red Desire's fulfillment lies right 
there.
choice_data_list: I'd like you to look at this.
I'd like you to take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

I show her a community site where racing 
fans gather. There, we see—

"We are wishing for Desire-sama's victory 
in the Shuka Sho!"

"Even if Buena scratches, I'm still going 
to the Shuka Sho to see Desire tear it 
up!!"

"Please run the Triple Tiara all the way 
to the very end, Desire...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
All I hear are voices expecting great 
things from me... from the Saint Red 
Desire at the Shuka Sho...!

What many fans wanted from Red Desire 
wasn't to follow Buena Vista and challenge 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, but—

...to crown her run with a victory in the 
Shuka Sho, the final race of the Triple 
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...To think I am desired this much.

Even without Buena Vista... if I can win 
the Shuka Sho decisively, I should surely 
be able to attain it.

The radiance of racing— The 'fulfillment' 
she seeks.
choice_data_list: I want you to seize the utmost brilliance.
I want you to seize the utmost brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I understand completely.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Even if Buena-san isn't here......—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I will aim for the final jewel of the 
Triple Tiara, the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: All of it—to reach "that place."

She faced forward despite her doubts. Yet 
in her heart, the smoldering spark of 
impatience to chase after her rival 
continued to burn.

Under the scorching summer sun, the story 
plunges into a grueling summer training 
camp.
